mentions.name: InfinitePod
mentions.description: This web app creates easy-to-understand stories and explainers for language learning. Learners can listen via their favourite podcast app or directly on the website with illustrations. It has been tested mainly with English, French, Japanese, and Mandarin, with plans to add more languages.
